decision_owner: Root coordinating agent; reasoned completion of the authorized J1 assignment, not J9 owner acceptance of a legal rule set.
scope: Jurisdiction-first source universe for residential physical work and outgoing-account resolution. Breakwater remains an application, not a source filter.
basis: The account chain has selected tenancy/security, contracts and payment, licensing/trust, collection/reporting, military, bankruptcy, representative authority, court/remedy, unclaimed-fund and record-security sources. Local layer absences name the actual parent-law branch rather than substituting unrelated local administration.

The physical-work chain has selected entry/possession, condition/building/fire/accessibility, location and environmental constraints, utility service, provider licensing/commitments, labor safety/payment/liens, and local adoption/fees/inspection sources. Sources connect work cost and responsibility without equating vendor cost with tenant liability.

Conditional housing, public-owner and assistance sources are selected for actual resident/property obligations. County and district geography, assistance participation and special residential status remain applicability conditions. Unsupported independent-business and government-administration additions have been excluded with substantive reasons.

Selected instruments have identified source units and acquisition routes. Adopted/future packages are distinguished from proposals, approvals and currently operative text. Specific unresolved filing intervals or final body acquisition are downstream tasks, not missing instrument-selection decisions.

Final review integrated delivered utility/local/regulatory selections, corrected stale source gaps, excluded unrelated standalone acts and supplied the identified Airport Fire originals. No outstanding instrument-selection decision remains in the reviewed aperture.
jev_role: Repeatable passage-level reference flags assist research; root/researchers decide referenced-source relevance. Existing FCC/Civil, CPUC and coherent TBRA runs have source followthrough. No negative score or count establishes completeness; fragmented MHTBRA supplemental run is excluded from coverage claims.
next_stage: J2: acquire and preserve the selected source text, its actual editions and coherent section boundaries. Do not rebuild scope from Breakwater or turn every new citation into another required instrument.
downstream_limits: GoGreen permanent agency adoption is directly established. OEHHA agency adoption/submission is an explicit inference from its affirmative OAL action record and statutory submission requirements. Neither OAL outcome is claimed established; resolve before applying those amendments.
Part7 filing/continuity, other identified adopted package final bodies/dates, and contradictory source history remain acquisition/interpretation responsibilities.
Repeated SCE form numbers in different folders have different file metadata. Preserve both source candidates until actual editions are reconciled; no duplicate obligations are inferred.
The selected source universe may be amended by a demonstrated later dependency or legal change. J1 completion does not claim that every section is acquired, interpreted or accepted.
verification_role: Schema/function/adapter checks verify clerical consistency only. Root source/scope reasoning establishes this decision.
implementation_state: Existing section/rule compilation not advanced; no Breakwater application or broad Jev redesign performed.
